clue.text: Not working, fusses about a lower level position

parts.note: a system that is down is not working

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece is wrapped round the other

parts.note: to stir is to make a fuss or cause trouble
taken as written

explanation.surface: An idle worker kicks up a fuss about being given a lowly post.
explanation.walkthrough: The A sits inside STIRS, after its first two letters, to give STAIRS.
explanation.definitionFit: Downstairs is the floor below, a place at a lower storey of a house.

clue.text: Ready to perform call for peace

parts.note: to do a piece is to perform it
the sound made to ask for quiet

explanation.surface: A performer stands by, waiting for the audience to hush.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ready' looks like an adjective, but it is the slang noun 'readies', cash; dosh is British slang for money.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal British words for cash money available to spend.

clue.text: Wide container for something very big

parts.note: W is the cricket abbreviation for a wide ball
a hopper is a funnel-shaped container for grain or coal

explanation.surface: A broad bin chosen to hold something huge.
explanation.definitionFit: A whopper is informal for an exceptionally large thing, or a huge lie.

clue.text: Extra cost to pay as Army, say, goes on attack

parts.note: the Army is one of the armed services; 'say' marks it as an example
a charge is a rushing attack

explanation.surface: A military assault, framed as an expense the taxpayer must meet.
explanation.definitionFit: A service charge is an additional fee added to a bill, as in a restaurant.

clue.text: Needing to be replanted — like dates, with one exception

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a plant that lives only one season and must be sown again
second meaning: calendar dates come round once a year, except 29 February

explanation.walkthrough: The second half is a cryptic hint: every date recurs yearly bar the leap day.
explanation.definitionFit: Annual means both a once-a-year event and a garden plant completing its life cycle in one year.

clue.text: Counter-attack putting queen in peril as ordered

indicators.note: ordered means put into a new order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: R for Regina, queen
taken as written

explanation.surface: A chess-like move that endangers the queen as a counter-strike.
explanation.definitionFit: A reprisal is an act of retaliation against an enemy for an earlier attack.

clue.text: Prepares to fight — that's a promise, ignoring the odds

indicators.note: dropping the odd-numbered letters leaves only every second one

parts.note: the even letters of the run of text after the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A soldier vows readiness for battle.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters start at the S of "that's": S A P R O M I S E, keeping the 2nd, 4th, 6th and 8th.
explanation.definitionFit: To arm is to equip with weapons ahead of combat, so arms is the third-person verb.

clue.text: Ribbed fabric is not commonly put on new coat

parts.note: rep is a fabric with a corded surface
ain't is the colloquial form of is not

explanation.surface: A tailor notes that corded cloth isn't usually used for a fresh coat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coat' looks like clothing beside the fabric, but it is a coat of paint.
explanation.definitionFit: To repaint is to apply a fresh layer of paint, a new coat.

clue.text: Playing to win hand

parts.note: surface reading: a card player trying to take a trick
setter's reading: making music beneath a window to win a lover's hand in marriage

explanation.walkthrough: 'Hand' suggests cards; it is the hand asked for in marriage, and the playing is music.
explanation.definitionFit: A suitor performing love songs to a beloved is courting with music.

clue.text: With endless amusement, directed part of Scottish outfit

indicators.note: without an end, so the final letter is cut off

parts.note: sport is fun or amusement
to run a business is to direct it

explanation.surface: Someone directed the costume department with constant good humour.
explanation.definitionFit: A sporran is the pouch worn at the front of a kilt in Highland dress.

clue.text: One making definite choice to be less slim

definitions.meaning: first meaning: someone who plumps for an option
second meaning: the comparative of plump, fatter

explanation.walkthrough: To plump for something is to settle on it decisively.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an agent noun from plump for and the comparative adjective of plump, meaning chubbier.

clue.text: Not quietening down, including one part of speech turned up full

indicators.note: including means holding something inside it

parts.note: unabated means not lessening in force
the Roman numeral

indicators.note: in a down entry, turned up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: a verb is a grammatical part of speech

explanation.surface: A grammar lesson about an unrelenting din, with a word class flipped over.
explanation.definitionFit: Unabbreviated means not shortened, so given in complete form.

clue.text: In hardship, it's a restructuring that's often opposed by unions

indicators.note: in places one set of letters inside another

parts.note: privation is lack of basic necessities

indicators.note: restructuring rebuilds something in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters I T S A rearranged

explanation.surface: A union warns that a company reorganisation is bringing hardship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Restructuring' reads as the definition but signals the shuffle; the definition is the clause after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Selling state industries to private owners is a policy trade unions have often resisted.

clue.text: Display garment for horse or rider

parts.note: to show is to display
a jumper is a British sweater

explanation.surface: A rider's outfit on display at an equestrian event.
explanation.definitionFit: A showjumper is either a horse trained to leap fences in competition or the person riding it.

clue.text: Musician has to quickly run around piano, right?

parts.note: to hare is to run fast
p is the musical marking for soft
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A musician asks whether they must dash round the piano.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Piano' looks like the instrument but is the dynamic marking, soft.
explanation.definitionFit: A harper is a player of the harp, so a musician.

clue.text: As religious leader, Edward talked at length

parts.note: a rabbi is a Jewish religious teacher
Ted is a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: Edward, a clergyman, gave a long-winded sermon.
explanation.walkthrough: To rabbit on is British slang for chattering endlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Rabbiting is informal British for talking at length about trivial things.

clue.text: It secures safe rent as arranged

indicators.note: arranged means set out in a fresh order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A tenancy agreement guarantees the rent is paid safely.
explanation.definitionFit: A fastener is a clasp or catch that holds something closed and secure.

clue.text: What can become ruined without male guard

indicators.note: without in its old sense means outside, so it wraps around a piece
something ruined is wrecked and rebuilt in a new form

parts.note: taken as written
M is the abbreviation for male

explanation.surface: A worry about what might be spoiled when there is no man around to protect it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Can' belongs both to the fodder and the indicator phrase; the anagrammed letters then go round M.
explanation.definitionFit: A watchman is someone employed to keep guard over a building at night.

clue.text: What we did, ultimately, with record of loans generating little interest

indicators.note: ultimately means in the end, so only last letters are taken

parts.note: the final letters of the three words
IOUs are written notes acknowledging debts

explanation.surface: A banker's admission that a ledger of loans earned very little interest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Interest' looks financial beside the loans, but it means attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tedious is boring, so it holds no one's attention.

clue.text: Flier for magician

definitions.meaning: second meaning: the wizard of Arthurian legend

explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to a small bird of prey and to King Arthur's legendary wizard.

clue.text: Roman soldiers holding king in chain

indicators.note: holding means keeping something inside its grasp

parts.note: a legion was a Roman army unit
R for Rex, king

explanation.surface: Legionaries keep a captured king in fetters.
explanation.definitionFit: A leg-iron is a shackle chained around a prisoner's ankle.

clue.text: I'd a son, awfully handsome boy

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A proud parent boasts of a very good-looking son.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Awfully' reads as an intensifier before handsome but is the shuffle signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Adonis was the beautiful youth of Greek myth, now a name for any attractive young man.

clue.text: Preparing to substitute for player, not learning enough

definitions.meaning: first meaning: learning a role to cover for an actor
second meaning: read as ..., doing too little study

explanation.walkthrough: The second meaning splits the word in two: under-studying.
explanation.definitionFit: An understudy learns a part so as to stand in for an absent actor.

clue.text: Severely criticise loud song for beat with excessive force

parts.note: f is the musical marking forte
a lay is a ballad or short song

explanation.surface: A critic savages a noisy song for its overly heavy beat.
explanation.walkthrough: Both ends define the answer, with the charade in between.
explanation.definitionFit: To flay is literally to whip or strip the skin, and figuratively to criticise harshly.

clue.text: Something body needs for energy put in container

parts.note: pro means in favour of

indicators.note: put in means placed inside another piece

parts.note: a tin is a metal container
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A dietary tip about something nourishing stored in a jar.
explanation.definitionFit: Protein is an essential nutrient the body uses to build and repair tissue.

clue.text: In part of Africa once, you are reportedly not affected

indicators.note: in places one piece inside another

parts.note: Natal was a former South African province

indicators.note: reportedly means as spoken, so it is the sound that counts

parts.note: the text-speak spelling that sounds the same

explanation.surface: A traveller in colonial Africa is told they seem untouched by it.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural behaviour is unaffected, meaning free of pretence or artificiality.

clue.text: Visible indication of ill feeling that's overhasty

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a skin eruption showing one feels unwell
second meaning: acting without due thought

explanation.walkthrough: 'Ill feeling' suggests resentment; it means feeling ill.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a noun for a skin outbreak and an adjective for impetuous, reckless actions.

clue.text: Pressure leading to post in hospital in top office

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure
a residency is a junior doctor's hospital training post

explanation.surface: Stress at work leads a doctor from a hospital job to the highest office.
explanation.definitionFit: The presidency is the role of president, the highest position in a state or organisation.
